Discussed Suz's ex-boyfriend, Ricky Churry, described as having 15 DUIs and engaging in extreme behavior like eating glass [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba8091b973fc6583b90e85][^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba808b901ff48c70a64410] - Conversation began with discussion about Ricky's relationship with his father and how others perceived him [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba8091b973fc6583b90e85][^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba8006b809fdb67a4b8e05][^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba80798b25ccaad829a76b] - Recounted an incident where Ricky's mother was heard screaming at him [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba805e96d5d34f3960a853] ### Physical Confrontation - The narrator described a violent encounter where Ricky slapped them in the face while they were watching a game [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba8011b743de20685b4abe][^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba80b1954dd56c68985da9] - The narrator retaliated by grabbing Ricky and beating him against glass [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba80599e73d8dd5a3fe17b][^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba8035a460cf5686c81fb1] - Eddie Cupp, who was working the register, intervened by grabbing the narrator's leg to prevent further violence [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba8035a460cf5686c81fb1] - State trooper Eric Canola and another trooper restrained the narrator [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba8086b4fce7d9ac838b90][^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba801ebfb1cdbaf808f633] - The troopers confirmed they witnessed the entire incident and let the narrator go, acknowledging Ricky had initiated the confrontation [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba801ebfb1cdbaf808f633][^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba80258f71e004e73bcba6] - The narrator emphasized this was the only time they had been slapped as an adult [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba8035a460cf5686c81fb1] ### Ricky's Behavior - Others present characterized Ricky as "nuts" and noted his unpredictable, erratic behavior [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba801da226e2334c8bca1a][^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba80e8a0ddd8dd9ca54de4] - Multiple people who met Ricky had similar reactions to his extreme conduct [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba808b901ff48c70a64410] taalking abiut suz’s ex boyfriend a craazy idiot with 15 dui’s and would eat glaass - Meeting note url: https://app.notion.com/p/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba804aac6cf6dfa3f87dc6 Ricky Churry Incident Follow-Up ### Aftermath of Confrontation - Discussion about potential legal consequences, with someone mentioning the incident "could go on for 10 years" [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba80ed93a1ee0802c74c37] - Questions raised about why police were involved, given the circumstances [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba80a4b1b3f5fdf0939904] ### Ricky's Emotional Breakdown - Eric brought Ricky back to Main Street after taking him to the barracks [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba8079a54ad6fc1f68ced1] - Ricky sat on the narrator's knees on Main Street and broke down crying [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba8079a54ad6fc1f68ced1] - Ricky apologized profusely, saying "Jordan, I love you, man" and "I don't know what's the matter with me" [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba80a8a03dec864a4d6264] - Ricky acknowledged his behavior wasn't excusable, indicating this pattern had happened before [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba80a8a03dec864a4d6264] ### Narrator's Response - The narrator told Ricky to get up and questioned his behavior [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba803884fbdf99953663d7] - Expressed confusion about Ricky's continuing pattern of problematic behavior [^https://www.notion.so/330198c327ba803b8cdddd8c9b5bd040#330198c327ba803884fbdf99953663d7]

Transcript omitted. To load it, fetch again with include_transcript: true.
